name: departures-board
title: Departures board
description: A departures board for stations, ferries and airports: time, destination, platform and a status in words, delays shown against the plan, changes announced politely.
docs: Pass departures ({ id, scheduled, expected, destination, via, platform, status, operator }) in any order; the board sorts them by the time they leave. scheduled and expected are ISO strings with their offset (or Z), timestamps or Dates, because the board has to know the day to know what has left. A delay is worked out from the two times and shown as the planned time struck through beside the new one; give status 'cancelled' or 'boarding' to say those, 'on-time' or 'delayed' to override the sum. now decides which rows have left (they fade back and say 'Departed'); leave it out to use the browser's clock, or pass it for the same page on the server and in tests. updated sets the 'Updated 14:32' stamp (default: now). Times are written in locale (default en-US; en-GB writes 14:35) in timeZone (default UTC; a zone that is not known falls back to UTC). Give departures a new array whenever the data updates: the rows that changed rest on a plate for a moment, and a polite live region says what changed in one sentence for the first three rows (cancellations first, then delays, boarding and platforms), gathered so a burst of updates is never a flood; the first paint says nothing. onSelect makes each destination a button. labels translates every word, and platform can be renamed Gate, Pier or Stand. Below 42rem each row is a card of two lines, or three when the stops and the operator do not fit beside the status, and they wrap instead of being cut off.
